source.title: Unique Homes | Villa KD45 Residence
source.description:
What if a house didn’t need a front or a back door?
Located in Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh, this 11,840 sq. ft. villa reimagines green architecture by blending its structure directly into the landscape.

With stepped pathways leading to a fully usable garden roof, preserved mature trees, and natural evaporative cooling pools, it effortlessly solves hot summer climate challenges while creating a seamless flow between indoor and outdoor living.

Proof that modern construction can thrive in complete harmony with nature.

Stay tuned for more inspiring homes!

pack.topic: Roof Thermal Insulation & Passive Cooling for Coimbatore Residences
pack.source_script_insight: The source video highlights Villa KD45's climate-smart design using landscaped terraced roofs, soil layers, deep cantilevers, and water bodies to prevent direct solar heat absorption on the building envelope.
pack.coimbatore_angle: In Coimbatore localities like Saravanampatti and Vadavalli, direct overhead sun during hot months warms RCC roof slabs, turning top-floor bedrooms into heat traps. Proper elastomeric waterproofing paired with thermal drainage mats and landscaped roof earth layers keeps top-floor ceilings up to 5°C cooler naturally.
pack.core_takeaway: Protect top-floor ceilings from intense solar heat gain by integrating multi-layer waterproofing, drainage mats, and landscaped soil insulation over RCC roof slabs.

pack.gemini_video_prompt:
Production Shot List for OliveTree Builders, COIMBATORE ONLY. EXACTLY 10 SECONDS, EXACTLY 7 SCENES. Photorealistic 9:16 vertical video captured on smartphone or gimbal in high-resolution, look 100% like real site footage in Tamil Nadu. Motion graphics are strict light 2D overlays only (text, subtle checkmarks, arrows).

SCENE 1 (0.0 - 1.4s): Real construction site in Coimbatore during hot daylight. Overhead sun flare shining down onto an open reinforced concrete roof terrace slab. Dust on concrete edge, realistic Indian residential site context. Camera: 24mm wide angle, eye-level tilt up to sky. Overlay text: 'Roof Heat Problem?'. Audio fragment: 'கோவை வெயிலில் மொட்டை மாடி சூடாகிறதா?'.

SCENE 2 (1.4 - 2.8s): Detailed close-up shot of raw concrete screed floor on terrace under direct sun. Realistic pores, curing sand traces, rough aggregate texture. A small transparent orange thermal pulse overlay highlights heat absorption. Camera: Low angle close-up with slight natural handheld wobble. Overlay text: 'Heat Transmission'. Audio fragment: 'காங்கிரீட் தளத்தில் வெப்பம் பரவுவதை தடுப்பது எப்படி?'.

SCENE 3 (2.8 - 4.2s): Construction worker wearing boots rolling black/dark-blue elastomeric waterproofing coat onto sloping concrete roof floor using a heavy paint roller. Smooth wet glossy finish contrasting against gray bare concrete. Camera: Medium over-the-shoulder tracking shot. Overlay text: 'Waterproof Coat'. Audio fragment: 'முதலில் வாட்டர்ப்ரூஃபிங் மெம்பிரேன்!'.

SCENE 4 (4.2 - 5.6s): Close-up shot showing hands laying black dimpled HDPE drainage sheet and white geotextile fabric over the dark dry waterproofed floor. Clean site craftsmanship. Camera: Top-down 45-degree angled view. Overlay text: 'Drainage Layer'. Audio fragment: 'மேலே ட்ரைனேஜ் மேட் மற்றும் மண் அடுக்கு!'.

SCENE 5 (5.6 - 7.0s): Worker using a wooden hand rake to gently spread lightweight potting soil mix over geotextile filter fabric in a designated roof garden bed. Sunlight dappled across terrace parapet wall. Camera: Low angle side-tracking shot. Overlay text: 'Green Roof Layer'. Audio fragment: 'இது வீட்டின் வெப்பத்தை குறைக்கும்!'.

SCENE 6 (7.0 - 8.5s): Smooth pan inside the top-floor master bedroom or living room directly under the insulated terrace. Clean plastered white ceiling, indirect false ceiling cove lighting, air circulating smoothly, warm comfortable indoor ambiance. Camera: Slow interior upward pan. Overlay text: 'Cool Interior Ceiling'. Audio fragment: 'குளிர்ச்சியான உள் தரைக்கூரை!'.

SCENE 7 (8.5 - 10.0s): Final exterior wide shot of a completed residential green roof terrace in Coimbatore featuring lush lawn patches, potted plants, neat glass parapet railings, and ambient afternoon sun. Subtle green checkmark graphic and text overlay: 'OliveTree Builders Quality'. Camera: Smooth backward gimbal pull-away shot. Audio fragment: 'ஆலிவ்ட்ரீ பில்டர்ஸ் மூலம் சரியான இன்சுலேஷன் அமைப்போம்!'.

CONTINUITY & VISUAL RULES: Maintains realistic Tamil Nadu site materials, realistic natural sunlight, consistent concrete textures, authentic worker attire, and realistic architectural proportions. NO full-screen graphic cards or cartoon animations. NO CGI rendering, 3D architectural gloss, toon characters, floating houses, fake futuristic skylines, or random presenters. Strictly real site execution with accurate thermal roof insulation layers.
pack.title_english: Beat Roof Solar Heat in Coimbatore Homes | OliveTree Builders
pack.caption_english:
Is your top-floor bedroom absorbing too much summer heat through the roof slab? Bare RCC roof slabs in Coimbatore easily absorb direct solar radiation, elevating indoor ceiling temperatures.

At OliveTree Builders, we execute systematic terrace thermal protection: high-grade elastomeric waterproofing membrane, followed by dimpled HDPE drainage board, filter geotextile, and lightweight green soil insulation layers. This multi-layered approach keeps top-floor ceilings up to 5°C cooler while preventing roof leakage.

Build climate-smart homes with proven engineering techniques. Contact OliveTree Builders Coimbatore today for professional site inspection and heat-resistant roof construction solutions.
